title: 第10章 中计？老子将计就计，烧你爹的尸！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

老丑顾不上体内伤势，轻功全开，一路疾行回木屋。

推开门。

床上只剩断绳。

夜璇早已不在。

老丑一拍大腿：“大意了，大意了，没想到，今天竟被个小姑娘耍了！“

随即自嘲冷笑：“马映雪，你还真是让我意外。竟聪慧至此。“

老丑心中推测，马映雪带着一人，应该没能走远。现下正是追赶的最后机会！

走出竹屋，左右查探。刚迈出几步，便觉不妥，眉头轻皱。

目下没有丝毫线索，这四面八方，哪能追上？

何不反其道而行，引蛇出洞。

他拖出马元庆尸身。

“马映雪，你好一招调虎离山之计，小老二佩服的紧！“他背对竹屋，声音经玄力激荡而去，“我中你计一次，岂有再中之理？“

“你无非是想等我离开，再折回收尸。我偏不让你如愿。“

随即老丑开始摆弄马元庆尸身，将银针扎遍尸身眉心、膻中、丹田等各大要穴。嘴中念念有词。

好一会才道：“你只需将我的女人还我。如若不然，我便将你父炼化为尸傀，从今往后，永不得超生！“

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The old man didn't care about his internal injuries, so he used all his Qinggong skills and hurried back to the cabin.

Push the door open.

Only broken ropes were left on the bed.

Ye Xuan is no longer here.

The old Chou slapped his thigh: "You were careless, you were careless. I didn't expect that I was tricked by a little girl today!"

Then he sneered at himself: "Ma Yingxue, you really surprised me. You are so smart."

Lao Chou speculated that Ma Yingxue could not go far with one person.Now is the last chance to catch up!

Walk out of the bamboo house and look around.After taking a few steps, he felt something was wrong and frowned slightly.

There is no clue at the moment. How can we catch up with him from all directions?

Why not do the opposite and lure the snake out of its hole.

He dragged out Ma Yuanqing's body.

"Ma Yingxue, you have a plan to lure the tiger away from the mountain. The little boy is very impressed!" He turned his back to the bamboo house, his voice was stirred by the mysterious force, "I fell into your trap once, how can I fall into it again?"

"You just want to wait for me to leave and then recycle the corpse. I won't let you do that."

Immediately, the old man began to play with Ma Yuanqing's body, pricking silver needles all over the body's major points such as the eyebrows, tanzhong, and Dantian.There are words in his mouth.

After a while, he said: "You only need to return my woman to me. If not, I will refine your father into a corpse puppet. From now on, he will never be reincarnated!"
